description: Clinical trials registered with the SFDA and running in Saudi Arabia (sourced from www.sfda.gov.sa/en/drug_clinical_trials_list): study title, sponsor, status, study drug, phase, protocol number, and trial site (hospital). Filters are applied by the SFDA server.

drug.description: Filter by study drug name substring, e.g. "VX 880".

page.description: Page number, zero-indexed (each page has 10-20 rows). Default 0.

site.description: Filter by trial site (hospital/city) substring, e.g. "Riyadh".

name: sfda_clinical_trials
title: Sfda Clinical Trials
